identity: SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.player_id) p.player_id,p.player_name,p.team_id,p.team_name,p.position,m.tournament_id,m.season_id,m.tournament_name,m.season_name,m.start_timestamp FROM player_match_stats p JOIN match m USING(match_id) WHERE lower(p.player_name)=lower(:player_name) AND (m.tournament_name ILIKE '%Indonesia%' OR m.tournament_name ILIKE '%Liga 1%') AND m.match_status='Ended' AND m.start_timestamp < :cutoff AND p.minutes_played > 0 ORDER BY p.player_id,m.start_timestamp DESC
opponent_identity: SELECT DISTINCT team_id,team_name FROM team_match_stats WHERE tournament_id=:tournament_id AND season_id=:season_id AND team_name ILIKE :opponent_name
next_fixtures: SELECT *,status_description AS match_status FROM match_schedule WHERE (home_team_id=:team_id OR away_team_id=:team_id) AND tournament_id=:tournament_id AND season_id=:season_id AND start_timestamp >= :cutoff AND lower(status_type) IN ('not started','notstarted','scheduled') ORDER BY start_timestamp,match_id LIMIT 5
matches: SELECT * FROM match WHERE tournament_id=:tournament_id AND season_id=:season_id AND match_status='Ended' AND start_timestamp < :cutoff ORDER BY start_timestamp,match_id
team_rows: SELECT t.*,m.start_timestamp,m.home_team_id,m.away_team_id,m.home_formation,m.away_formation,m.home_score,m.away_score FROM team_match_stats t JOIN match m USING(match_id) WHERE m.tournament_id=:tournament_id AND m.season_id=:season_id AND m.match_status='Ended' AND m.start_timestamp < :cutoff ORDER BY m.start_timestamp,t.team_id
player_rows: SELECT p.*,m.start_timestamp FROM player_match_stats p JOIN match m USING(match_id) WHERE m.tournament_id=:tournament_id AND m.season_id=:season_id AND m.match_status='Ended' AND m.start_timestamp < :cutoff AND p.minutes_played > 0 ORDER BY m.start_timestamp,p.player_id
positions: SELECT a.*,p.team_id,p.position,p.jersey_number,p.substitute,p.minutes_played,m.start_timestamp,m.home_team_id,m.away_team_id FROM player_average_positions a JOIN player_match_stats p USING(match_id,player_id) JOIN match m USING(match_id) WHERE m.tournament_id=:tournament_id AND m.season_id=:season_id AND m.match_status='Ended' AND m.start_timestamp < :cutoff AND p.minutes_played > 0 AND p.team_id IN (:team_id,:opponent_id)
heatmaps: SELECT h.match_id,h.player_id,h.x,h.y,p.team_id,m.start_timestamp FROM heatmap_player_match h JOIN player_match_stats p USING(match_id,player_id) JOIN match m USING(match_id) WHERE m.tournament_id=:tournament_id AND m.season_id=:season_id AND m.match_status='Ended' AND m.start_timestamp < :cutoff AND p.minutes_played > 0 AND p.team_id=:opponent_id
ratings: SELECT * FROM player_category_rating_season WHERE tournament_id=:tournament_id AND season_id=:season_id
details: SELECT player_id,player_name,team_id,team_name,position,positions_detailed,dob FROM player_league_details WHERE tournament_id=:tournament_id AND season_id=:season_id
style_profiles: SELECT * FROM team_style_profile WHERE tournament_id=:tournament_id AND season_id=:season_id
schema: SELECT table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name IN ('player_category_rating_season_history','player_match_derived_stats','team_match_stats','player_match_stats') ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position
derived: SELECT d.*,m.start_timestamp FROM player_match_derived_stats d JOIN match m USING(match_id) WHERE m.tournament_id=:tournament_id AND m.season_id=:season_id AND m.match_status='Ended' AND m.start_timestamp < :cutoff AND d.minutes_played > 0 ORDER BY d.player_id,m.start_timestamp
